Topic.label: Estimating the population mean using the sample mean

Question: To estimate the mean height of all students in a school, which of the following sampling methods is the most reasonable? ( )

Choices.A: Select only students on the basketball team
Choices.C: Select only the tallest student in each class
Choices.D: Randomly select students from the entire school

Solution: Random selection gives every student an equal chance of being selected, making the sample representative. The samples obtained by the other methods are all biased.

Meta.LabelProvenance: Domain from upstream category; provisional skill from upstream topic, not a formula-level judgment.

Original.prompt: 为估计全校学生的平均身高，下列抽样方法最合理的是（ ）

choices.text: 从全校学生中随机抽取

Original.explanation: 随机抽取使每个学生被抽到的机会均等，样本才有代表性；其余方法的样本都有偏向。
